flags.detail: Prices in this decision layer were captured across 25–26 Nov 2026 by different research sessions, not re-quoted live on 27 Nov. Room types, promotion eligibility, cancellation terms, and tax/service treatment differ; use each source link and re-check the exact rate before booking.
